sources.title: Llama Guard 3 | Model Cards and Prompt formats - dev.meta.ai
sources.snippet: This update builds on the capabilities introduced in Llama Guard 3 by adding a multimodal model (11B) for image + text input evaluation, and also a smaller text-only model (1B) for on-device and cloud safety evaluations. The prompt format is consistent with the existing one, but with the addition of a new special token to handle image input. Download Llama 3.2 models.

sources.title: Llama-Guard-3-1B | Model Catalog | Microsoft Foundry
sources.snippet: Llama Guard 3-1B is a fine-tuned Llama-3.2-1B pretrained model for content safety classification. Similar to previous versions, it can be used to classify content in both LLM inputs (prompt classification) and in LLM responses (response classification).
